description: Assign (or, with remove: true, unassign) users on an issue or pull request. Real assignees since 2026-10-12 — up to 10 per thread, only users who can read the repository; the old `assignee:<username>` labels were migrated. Pass `assignee` (one username) or `assignees` (array). `type` is 'issue' (default) or 'pull_request'. Requires 'repo' scope and write access. Returns {assigned, skipped:[{username, reason}], removed, assignees}.

remove.description: Unassign the given users instead (default false)

name: gluecron_assign_issue
